summary: Empirical Playwright verification (desktop 1280x900, https://ironrabbit-edit.preview.emergentagent.com) of the new 'Edit Canvas View' toggle in NoteModal (NoteModal.jsx L46-51, L417-470). Opened the 'T2' accordion → accordion-edit-{id} → modal 'Edit Note' header visible → verified the toggle data-testid='note-canvas-view-toggle'. All critical scenarios PASS.

click_expands_canvas.note: max-w-lg (512px) → max-w-5xl (1024px) applied; max-h grew to 95vh (855px of 900).

icon_swaps_maximize_to_minimize.note: Visible in screenshot — icon shows Minimize2 next to the ? button after expand.

reset_on_reopen.note: NoteModal.jsx L411 'if (!isOpen) return null' unmounts the component on close; canvasExpanded is useState(false) so every reopen starts in 'normal'. Empirical reopen in test session was flaky only due to accordion needing re-expansion (unrelated to the feature).

action_items: No action required. Edit Canvas View toggle is correctly wired: button data-testid='note-canvas-view-toggle', aria-pressed/data-state/aria-label all flip, dialog width doubles (max-w-lg → max-w-5xl), max-height grows (85vh → 95vh), editor min-h and textarea min/max rows adjust (NoteModal.jsx L545, L563-564). Reset-on-reopen is guaranteed by component unmount pattern (L411).
critical_code_review_comments: NoteModal.jsx L51: canvasExpanded is correctly a local useState (not persisted) — matches the stated requirement 'resets each open'. Component unmount via `if (!isOpen) return null` at L411 guarantees fresh state on every open.

L417-418: Tailwind transition `transition-[max-width,max-height] duration-200 ease-out` on DialogContent gives smooth 200ms animation. Width transition from max-w-lg to max-w-5xl is visually confirmed.
L451-463: Toggle Button has strong a11y — aria-pressed, aria-label, title all swap based on state. data-testid='note-canvas-view-toggle' and data-state='expanded|normal' provide robust test hooks.
L545: Editor min-h-[22rem] max-h-[65vh] (expanded) vs min-h-[5.5rem] max-h-[26rem] (normal). L563-564: textarea minRows 14/3 and maxRows 32/20 pair sensibly with the dialog growth.
No regression on sibling header controls (Templates, Help QuickGuideButton, DisplayControlsButton) — they remain adjacent and clickable; `mr-8` reserves clearance from Dialog's absolute Close (X).
Pre-existing LOW anomaly from iteration_119/120/121 (FloatingRichTextToolbar Bold button not wrapping selection) is unrelated to this feature and was not re-tested.

success_rate.frontend: 6/6 empirical scenarios PASS; reset-on-reopen verified by code inspection.

seed_data_creation: Used existing note 'T2' under Uncategorized category (opened via accordion-edit button).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Repro: desktop 1280x900 → open app → expand Uncategorized → click T2 accordion → click data-testid='accordion-edit-{noteId}' → modal 'Edit Note' opens → click data-testid='note-canvas-view-toggle'. Dialog width goes 512→1024, max-h grows to 95vh, icon flips Maximize2↔Minimize2, aria/data attrs all flip. Reopening the modal starts in normal state because NoteModal unmounts on close (`if (!isOpen) return null`).
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — new feature verification, no bug.
